# Rotabo

> Local marketplace for services and gear, zero commission

Rotabo is a global, zero-commission marketplace for local services, help and
equipment. Someone needs something; someone nearby already has it. Rotabo
connects the two and then gets out of the way.

Anyone can join and post for free, on either side: as someone looking, or as
someone offering time, skills, tools or space. Listings sit in 12 categories -
Drive, Translator, Move, Build, Tools, Home, Auto, Borrowed Grandparents,
Teachers, Vacation Stays, Pets and Something Else - plus a free-text request
for anything that does not fit, and each listing stays visible for 12 months.

Rotabo takes no percentage of what you earn. No commission, no booking fee,
no cut of the job: you agree the price directly with the other person and
keep all of it. The only optional payment is 2 CHF for a year of full access
to contact details across the marketplace, which is what keeps the platform
running instead of a commission.

Every member also gets a Rotabo number - a permanent personal ID shown in a
public live list as number, name, country flag and category. People write
their number on a banknote, a business card or a van door, and whoever finds
it can look the person up on rotabo.app. Hence the slogan: Need Me! Find Me!
On a Banknote!

Rotabo is an installable progressive web app in 38 languages with
email-verified listings, and it began as a designated-driver service - you
drink, they drive, your car - which is still one of its categories. Swiss
made, available worldwide.

## Key pages
- [Home](https://rotabo.app/): post what you need or what you offer, and browse who is nearby
- [For businesses](https://rotabo.app/business.html): company listings and sponsorship
- [Terms](https://rotabo.app/terms.html): terms of service
- [Privacy](https://rotabo.app/privacy.html): privacy policy
